CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that every audited region is covered by a logging CloudTrail trail (a multi-region trail or a trail homed in that region).
Risk: Regions without CloudTrail are blind spots: API activity there, including attacker activity in unused regions, is not recorded.

Code.CLI: aws cloudtrail create-trail --name <trail> --s3-bucket-name <bucket> --is-multi-region-trail && aws cloudtrail start-logging --name <trail>

Recommendation.Text: Create a multi-region trail (or organization trail) that logs management events and keep it logging.
